subject: Pilot credit conditional acceptance and DD requests
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Walker <elliot@catalyze.dev>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit conditional acceptance and DD requests

Hi Elliot —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to move forward with a conditional pilot top-up (additional $15k in credits) while we complete a short diligence checklist. The top-up would be time-limited (90 days) and tied to the milestones below.

Proposed quick MAA (mutual action plan):
- Week 1: Access & integration test (API keys + sample dataset)
- Week 3: Latency/cost baseline report from your staging traffic
- Week 6: Feature validation (generation quality checks)

To approve the credit today I need two things from you: 1) a signed MAA (attached stub) or an acceptance email, and 2) the minimal procurement details so our finance team can route the SOW/PO (company legal name, billing address, and the associated contact).

I attached a one-page MAA stub for convenience (MAA_Catalyze_2027.pdf). If you prefer, we can also send over DocuSign.

CC-ing Tessa from Sales Ops to support the SOW/PO path. If everything looks good I can provision the pilot top-up by EOD.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: MAA_Catalyze_2027.pdf (one-page mutual action plan stub)

From: Elliot Walker <elliot@catalyze.dev>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit conditional acceptance and DD requests

Chloe —

Appreciate the fast follow up. Catalyze Dev is happy to accept the conditional top-up, provided we align on two small items: 1) milestone 3 metrics (what counts as pass/fail), and 2) data retention limits during the pilot.

Procurement info below for SOW routing:
- Legal name: Catalyze Development, Inc.
- Billing address: 88 Elm Street, Suite 600, Boston, MA 02110
- Accounting contact: Priya Shah <priya.shah@catalyze.dev>

On milestones: for feature validation we typically require a precision/recall-style check for our generation prompts. If you can provide a short template for the validation checklist we will run it against our test corpus. For retention — we need logs + KV cache retained for 30 days and nothing persisted after.

If you send the MAA as DocuSign we can sign today. Also attaching a brief runbook describing our QA checks (SOW-v0.3.docx) — not full DD but should help define milestone 3.

Thanks,
Elliot
Head of Product | Catalyze Dev
elliot@catalyze.dev

Attachment: SOW-v0.3.docx (QA/runbook excerpt)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit conditional acceptance and DD requests

Chloe / Tessa —

Reviewed Elliot's note. Fine to provision the $15k pilot top-up under the conditions described:
- Top-up valid for 90 days from provisioning date
- Milestone acceptance: pass = 75%+ of Catalyze's validation criteria (per their runbook)
- Retention: logs and KV cache retained for 30 days only and purged automatically thereafter

Tessa — please prepare the SOW using Catalyze Development, Inc. details and include the credit allocation line with a note that it is conditional on milestone acceptance. Also add the standard pilot T&Cs (no data resale clause). Once SOW is in place we can send DocuSign link to Catalyze.

Chloe — I authorize you to provision the credits once we have either: 1) signed MAA/DocuSign OR 2) an explicit acceptance email plus procurement contact to route the SOW.

Marcus Lin
Director, Sales — Growth Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
